whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr. / Team Cosmetica Dental Clinic,

I noticed your clinic has an outstanding 4.9★ rating with 264+ reviews in Kankarbagh, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new patient appointments.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, orthodontic & dental service menu, aur patient testimonials integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cosmetica

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Cosmetica Dental Clinic, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp appointment booking and your 4.9-star ratings in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual clinic photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
